properties.description: Revision after the third content-only report from the Grok population and the first from Anthony's own hands: on 2026-09-15 his Grok Build 1.0.30 session on this repo received the signpost sentence and nothing else for maturity_report, what_next, scan_nodes and open_questions, and its session store held no copy of structuredContent. The 2026-08-23 signpost shape was chosen against "a client nobody could name"; three reports named one, and OpenCode (2026-09-14) was a second. This epoch records the mechanism that answers both without reopening the 2× wire cost for the clients that read structuredContent: the content block is keyed on the handshake name in call_tool, with an operator override. MUST NOT: reintroduce the unbounded duplicate for every client (the reply budget bounds it, the per-client key limits who pays); guess at a client's behaviour that was not measured (Grok's empty-text fallback is unmeasured and Grok therefore gets `duplicate`, the shape measured to reach its model). The decision dec:idea-how-does-a-content-only-client-get-an-answer stays the owner's; the merge of the PR carrying this epoch is his word on the mechanism, and switching any client — or every client — to strictly structured is a one-line change once the empty-text probe (scratchpad grokprobe/, waiting on Grok quota) has run.
properties.name: The content block is chosen per client (2026-09-15)
